function.name: get_url_content
function.description: Scrapes the specified URL for textual data and returns the content as a string. This function is useful for extracting information from web pages when a URL is provided. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The web address of the page to scrape. It should be a valid URL format, such as 'http://www.example.com'.

timeout.description: The maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, with a default value that allows for a reasonable amount of time for most web pages to load.

user_agent.description: The User-Agent string to be used for the HTTP request to simulate a particular browser, which is optional. Some websites may require this for access.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the most common “tools” (websites, apps, APIs, and platforms) you can use to book flights, from consumer‑facing services to developer‑ready APIs:

| Category | Tool / Service | What it does | Typical Use‑Case |
|----------|----------------|--------------|------------------|
| **Consumer flight‑search & booking sites** | **Google Flights** | Search, compare, and book flights directly (often redirects to airline/OTA). | Quick price comparison, itinerary planning. |
| | **Kayak** | Aggregates fares from many OTAs and airlines, offers price alerts. | Multi‑carrier itineraries, flexible dates. |
| | **Skyscanner** | Global fare aggregator, “cheapest month” feature. | Budget travel, long‑haul flights. |
| | **Expedia / Hotels.com** | Full travel package (flight + hotel + car). | One‑stop booking for trips. |
| | **Priceline / Hotwire** | “Name Your Own Price” and “Express Deals” for discounted fares. | Last‑minute deals, price‑sensitive travelers. |
| | **Orbitz / Travelocity** | Similar to Expedia, often bundled with loyalty points. | Frequent‑flyer integration. |
| | **Momondo** | Aggregates fares, shows price trends. | Visual price comparison. |
| | **Airline‑specific sites** (e.g., Delta, United, Emirates, Qantas) | Direct booking, loyalty benefits, seat selection. | Loyalty program members, direct support. |
| | **Travel agencies / OTAs** (e.g., Booking.com, Trip.com, Ctrip) | Localised booking, often cheaper in certain regions. | International travelers, Asian markets. |
| | **Mobile apps** (e.g., Hopper, Skyscanner, Google Flights app) | Push notifications, price predictions. | On‑the‑go price alerts. |
| **Developer APIs** | **Amadeus for Developers** | Flight search, booking, pricing, seat availability. | Integrate flight booking into your own app. |
| | **Sabre APIs** | Comprehensive travel data, booking, inventory. | Enterprise travel agencies. |
| | **Travelport APIs** | Global distribution system (GDS) access. | Large‑scale travel solutions. |
| | **Skyscanner API** | Search, price alerts, flight data. | Build custom flight search widgets. |
| | **Google Flights API (unofficial)** | Not officially public, but some wrappers exist. | Quick flight data retrieval. |
| | **FlightAware API** | Real‑time flight status, tracking. | Flight status integration. |
| | **OpenSky Network API** | Real‑time flight data, open source. | Aviation analytics. |
| | **FlightStats API** | Flight status, delays, historical data. | Operational analytics. |
| | **AirLabs API** | Flight search, pricing, seat availability. | Travel tech startups. |
| | **FlightRadar24 API** | Live flight tracking. | Real‑time flight monitoring. |
| | **Travelpayouts API** | Affiliate flight booking, commission. | Monetise flight search. |
| | **Kiwi.com API** | Multi‑city, multi‑carrier itineraries. | Complex routing. |
| | **CheapOair API** | Flight search & booking. | Affiliate marketing. |
| | **Trip.com API** | Global flight search, booking. | Chinese market focus. |
| | **Airline GDS APIs** (e.g., Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport) | Direct inventory access. | Enterprise travel agencies. |
| **Other tools** | **Hopper** (mobile app) | Predicts price changes, suggests best booking time. | Price‑prediction. |
| | **TripIt** | Organises itineraries, integrates with email. | Travel planning. |
| | **Google Calendar + Flight Alerts** | Sync flight details, receive reminders. | Personal scheduling. |
| | **FlightAware Flight Tracking** | Real‑time flight status, ETA. | Monitoring flights. |
| | **FlightStats Flight Status** | Delays, cancellations, gate info. | Operational updates. |
| | **FlightRadar24** | Live flight tracking, radar view. | Visual flight monitoring. |

### How to choose

| Need | Recommended Tool |
|------|------------------|
| **Fast price comparison** | Google Flights, Skyscanner, Kayak |
| **Last‑minute deals** | Priceline, Hotwire |
| **Bundle flight + hotel** | Expedia, Orbitz |
| **Loyalty program benefits** | Airline‑specific sites |
| **Mobile price alerts** | Hopper, Skyscanner app |
| **Integrate booking into your own app** | Amadeus, Sabre, Travelport, Skyscanner API |
| **Real‑time flight status** | FlightAware, FlightStats, FlightRadar24 |
| **Affiliate monetisation** | Travelpayouts, CheapOair, Skyscanner Affiliate |
| **Complex multi‑city itineraries** | Kiwi.com, Amadeus, Sabre |

Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details on any specific platform, how to integrate an API, or how to set up price alerts!
